reader_summary.overview: This special episode of the a16z Podcast is based on a Q&A from an early screening we hosted of Disney's Queen of Katwe. The movie -- directed by Mira Nair and based on a book by Tim Crothers -- depicts the true story of Ugandan chess prodigy Phiona Mutesi.
